scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @valsoft/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @valsoft/shared && npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test:ci: npm run prisma:migrate:deploy --workspace api && npm run test --workspace api -- --runInBand
scripts.db:up: docker compose up -d db db-test supabase-auth supabase-gateway
scripts.db:logs: docker compose logs -f db db-test supabase-auth supabase-gateway
